# TextStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines the visual style for text rendering. Properties left unset inherit from the parent RichText element's defaultStyle.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new TextStyle(options?: TextStyleOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Background highlight color behind the text.
- [`baselineAlignment`](#baselinealignment): Semantic vertical alignment (super/subscript).
- [`baselineShift`](#baselineshift): Explicit baseline shift in points (positive = up).
- [`color`](#color): Text color.
- [`decoration`](#decoration): Text decoration (underline, strikethrough, overline, or a combination).
- [`decorationColor`](#decorationcolor): Colour of the decoration lines (underline/strikethrough/overline).
- [`decorationStyle`](#decorationstyle): Line style for decorations.
- [`decorationThickness`](#decorationthickness): Thickness of the decoration lines in points.
- [`effectiveColor`](#effectivecolor): Returns the effective text color, defaulting to black if not set.
- [`effectiveFontName`](#effectivefontname): Returns the effective font name, resolving family+weight+italic or defaulting to Helvetica.
- [`effectiveFontSize`](#effectivefontsize): Returns the effective font size, defaulting to 12 if not set.
- [`fontFamily`](#fontfamily): Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica") or TTF file path.
- [`fontFeatures`](#fontfeatures): OpenType feature overrides, e.g. { kern: 0, liga: 0, smcp: 1 }.
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Font size in points.
- [`fontWeight`](#fontweight): Font weight (100-900).
- [`italic`](#italic): Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style.
- [`letterSpacing`](#letterspacing): Extra spacing in points added after every glyph (tracking).
- [`lineHeight`](#lineheight): Line-height multiplier applied to font size.
- [`resolvedFontName`](#resolvedfontname): Resolves the actual PDF font name by combining fontFamily + weight + italic through the FontFamilyResolver.
- [`wordSpacing`](#wordspacing): Extra spacing in points added after every space (word spacing).

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color | undefined
```

Background highlight color behind the text. Undefined = no highlight. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `baselineAlignment`

```typescript
baselineAlignment: BaselineAlignment
```

Semantic vertical alignment (super/subscript). See [`BaselineAlignment`](baseline-alignment.md). The shift magnitude derives from `effectiveFontSize` unless `baselineShift` is set explicitly. Accepts `'baseline' | 'superscript' | 'subscript'`.

### `baselineShift`

```typescript
baselineShift: number | undefined
```

Explicit baseline shift in points (positive = up). Overrides the magnitude implied by `baselineAlignment`. Null = derive from the alignment.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color | undefined
```

Text color. Undefined = inherit from parent. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-600'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`).

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
unitStyle.color = ColorPalette.slate[400];
```

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
labelStyle.color = ColorPalette.slate[800];
```

### `decoration`

```typescript
decoration: TextDecoration
```

Text decoration (underline, strikethrough, overline, or a combination). Accepts a single token, or a list for combinations: `['underline', 'overline']`.

### `decorationColor`

```typescript
decorationColor: Color | undefined
```

Colour of the decoration lines (underline/strikethrough/overline). Undefined = use the text `color`, which is the default. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `decorationStyle`

```typescript
decorationStyle: DecorationStyle
```

Line style for decorations. Default solid. Accepts `'solid' | 'wavy' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'`.

### `decorationThickness`

```typescript
decorationThickness: number | undefined
```

Thickness of the decoration lines in points. Null = the default derived from font size (`max(0.5, fontSize / 18)`).

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `effectiveColor`

```typescript
readonly effectiveColor: Color
```

*read-only*

Returns the effective text color, defaulting to black if not set.

### `effectiveFontName`

```typescript
readonly effectiveFontName: string
```

*read-only*

Returns the effective font name, resolving family+weight+italic or defaulting to Helvetica. When fontFamily is null, uses Helvetica as the base family so that weight/italic are still applied (e.g. Bold with no family → "Helvetica-Bold", not plain "Helvetica").

### `effectiveFontSize`

```typescript
readonly effectiveFontSize: number
```

*read-only*

Returns the effective font size, defaulting to 12 if not set.

### `fontFamily`

```typescript
fontFamily?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica") or TTF file path. Null = inherit from parent.

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
unitStyle.fontFamily = 'Helvetica';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
labelStyle.fontFamily = 'Helvetica';
```

### `fontFeatures`

```typescript
fontFeatures: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | undefined
```

OpenType feature overrides, e.g. { kern: 0, liga: 0, smcp: 1 }. Omitted values use font defaults.

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize: number | undefined
```

Font size in points. Null = inherit from parent.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'12pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
unitStyle.fontSize = 9;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
disclaimerBase.fontSize = 10;
```

### `fontWeight`

```typescript
fontWeight: FontWeight
```

Font weight (100-900). Normal = 400, Bold = 700. Accepts `'bold'`, `'semi-bold'`, … or the numeric value.

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
boldItalic.fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
labelStyle.fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold;
```

### `italic`

```typescript
italic: boolean
```

Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style.

Example, from `code-recipes/text-styling/rich-text-styles`:

```typescript
boldItalic.italic = true;
```

### `letterSpacing`

```typescript
letterSpacing: number | undefined
```

Extra spacing in points added after every glyph (tracking). Null = 0. Changes advances, so it flows through measurement, PDF (`Tc`), and SVG.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `lineHeight`

```typescript
lineHeight?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Line-height multiplier applied to font size. Null = inherit (1.2 if not set anywhere). Set to 1.5 for looser leading or 1.0 for tight leading.

### `resolvedFontName`

```typescript
readonly resolvedFontName: string | undefined
```

*read-only*

Resolves the actual PDF font name by combining fontFamily + weight + italic through the FontFamilyResolver.

### `wordSpacing`

```typescript
wordSpacing: number | undefined
```

Extra spacing in points added after every space (word spacing). Null = 0. Changes advances, so it flows through measurement, PDF, and SVG.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `bold`

```typescript
bold(): TextStyle
```

### `clone`

```typescript
clone(): TextStyle
```

Returns an independent copy of this style.

The fluent builders (`bold()`, `withColor()`, `subscript()`, …) mutate and return `this`, so a style shared across several `RichText` spans and mutated between them would otherwise leak its final state back onto the earlier spans. `RichText.span()` clones the style on the way in for exactly this reason; callers can also clone explicitly to fork a base style. All fields are value types (`Color` is immutable), so a shallow copy is a full copy.

### `mergeWith`

```typescript
mergeWith(baseStyle: TextStyle): TextStyle
```

Creates a merged style where this style's non-null values override the base style's values. Used to combine a span's local style with the RichText element's default style.
